shot.title: 婚礼前：扶正胸花，相视一笑
shot.start_end_and_action: A closer smartphone view from another friend within the same wedding arcade, still on the same side of the couple's axis. Continue the bride's raised right hand from the previous shot. She gently straightens the small boutonniere on the groom's left lapel, withdraws her hand, and looks into his eyes. The same groom smiles back softly. Keep their established adult faces, dark suit, white dress, low hair bun and warm dusk lighting. Frame from mid-torso upward so the flower, hand and two faces remain visible. Nearly locked camera. End after their small shared smile, with the flower remaining straight.
